title: A PDE approach to Benamou--Brenier formula for the Schrödinger problem
summary: We studied the Benamou--Brenier formulation of the Schrödinger problem, focusing on a gap between theoretical results and applications, that often involve measures with unbounded support. While the existing proof in the literature relies on the compactness of the marginals' supports to ensure the necessary regularity of the Schrödinger potentials, we extend the validity of the Benamou--Brenier formula to the larger class of sub-Gaussian probability measures. Exploiting fine estimates on the Hessian of the potentials and the entropic interpolation, we provide an almost self-contained proof…
